title: Bare smoke
scope: e2e/bare-smoke.mjs loads the Bare entry and signs in through a fetch supplied by the script. The account is built in the script. It opens no network connection.

entries.mechanism: [ref 0] returns a fixed challenge for the sign-in message, a stub access token for POST /v1/auth, and HTTP 404 for every other path. [ref 1] constructs DfxProtocol with that fetch.
entries.doesNotProve: A green run does not prove that the DFX API signs this account in or reports a missing transaction this way.

anchor: const protocol = new DfxProtocol(account, { environment: 'sandbox', network: 'polygon', fetch })

entries.status: fake — hand-built account with fixed signatures
entries.mechanism: [ref 0] says the owner address, the Safe and both signatures were derived ahead of time with an ethers Wallet using private key 2 and abstractionkit SafeAccountV0_3_0 with WDK Safe 0.3.0 parameters. [ref 3] says the owner is public test key 2 and the factory data comes from abstractionkit SafeAccountV0_3_0 with the WDK Safe 0.3.0 parameters, and that the inner signature is 0x + 11 x 64 + 1b. [ref 2] is that pattern, 0x then the characters 11 repeated 64 times then 1b, and it is not a derived signature. [ref 1] returns the Safe from getAddress, returns the fixed owner signature from sign when the message is the challenge and 0x otherwise, and returns that pattern from signTypedData.
entries.insteadOf: a WDK account that signs the challenge and the Safe typed data
entries.doesNotProve: A green run does not prove that a WDK account produces these signatures.

entries.status: fake — a placeholder that looks real
entries.mechanism: [ref 0] sets the Safe signature to 0x, then the characters 11 repeated 64 times, then 1b. That is 65 bytes ending in recovery id 27, the shape of an EOA signature, and it is a repeated pattern rather than a signature derived from the typed data. [ref 1] names that same pattern as the inner signature inside the expected ERC-6492 wrapper.
entries.insteadOf: a signature produced for the Safe sign-in typed data
entries.doesNotProve: A green run does not prove that this value is a signature a Safe or its owner produced.
